title: Legal Notice No. 2 of 2026 — THE PETROLEUM PRODUCTION LEVY AND SUBSIDY (GROSS MARGIN) (L.P.G.) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2025
text:
Legal Supplement Part B—Vol. 65, No. 3—8th January, 2026 3
LEGAL NOTICE NO. 2
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
THE PETROLEUM PRODUCTION LEVY AND SUBSIDY ACT, CHAP. 62:02
CORRIGENDUM
(In respect of Legal Notice No. 491 of 2025)
THE PETROLEUM PRODUCTION LEVY AND SUBSIDY
(GROSS MARGIN) (L.P.G.) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2025
IN the Petroleum Production Levy and Subsidy (Gross Margin) (L.P.G.)
(Amendment) Order, 2025 (Legal Notice 491 of 2025), published in the
Trinidad and Tobago Gazette, Legal Supplement Part B, Volume 64,
No. 190, on 31st December, 2025, in clause 3, in the second column of the
table, delete the word “litre” and substitute the word “pound”.
PRINTED AND PUBLISHED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, CARONI
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO–2026
